messages:
sara (People Ops): quick follow-up from today's all-hands on hiring + org changes. dropping concise answers here. drop short q's.
kevin (CEO): headline: reallocate headcount to infra, runtime, and enterprise reliability. this supports private deployments and SLAs.
tara (Head of Eng): note: were consolidating some overlapping teams to reduce handoffs. expected net effect = same or slightly higher headcount over FY.
noah (SWE): will this affect sprint commitments this quarter?
tara (Head of Eng): minimal impact. handoffs staged across sprints; owners keep current commitments for 2 cycles.
yara (Eng Manager): manager hiring question: freeze or open?
kevin (CEO): manager hires are limited. hire managers only when they unlock >2x team throughput or are compliance needed. otherwise prefer senior ICs.
mike (VP Infra): infra & SRE get priority approvals. if youre oncall-short, flag reqs as "infra-urgent".
ivy (Recruiter): process note: "infra-urgent" reqs -> post in ~48-72h. standard priority -> ~7-10 business days. please include 2 measurable outcomes on the req.
sara (People Ops): headcount preview (will publish spreadsheet tomorrow):
```
Q1 tactical: +8 (infra 4, runtime 2, reliability 2)
Q2 strategic: +15 (platform 6, enterprise 5, research 4)
Backfills: 6
```
noah (SWE): contractors allowed for demos/experiments?
tara (Head of Eng): yes, short-term contractors allowed (<=12 weeks) for experiments only. long-term ownership roles should be FT.
yara (Eng Manager): will there be a public mapping so people can see their team assignments?
sara (People Ops): yes  we'll publish a mapping with flags: "retained", "open", "under-review" plus short rationale. internal mobility window opens 7 business days after publication.
desk-bot: Reminder: all new reqs must use the updated template by Friday. link: https://redwood/internal/hiring-req
noah (SWE): curious how this affects leveling & career ladders?
kevin (CEO): no immediate leveling changes; any ladder updates will be separate communications.
sara (People Ops): we'll compile this thread into a short FAQ and attach to the all-hands notes. DM me or @ivy for private follow-ups. :v:
